title.narrative: Implement a suitable framework for Treasury Single Account.

comment.narrative: Bank accounts were controlled by provinces and the central government did not have any control or idea about the extent of bankaccounts or the financial position.

Implement a suitable framework of Treasury Single Account to manage the government financial resources by 2010. This means thatallspending accounts across the countries (except technical revenues) have been transferred under control of the National Treasury.

Indicator Achieved. MOF Implemented Consolidated Treasury Account system as per Budget Law 2007-8. This allowed the Treasury totake control of all spending accounts (excluding technical revenues) from provinces. This led to significant improvement in theoverall cash management system in the country

title.narrative: Procurement standard manuals ready for training.

comment.narrative: Currently the standard bidding documents have been prepared but not adopted.
Operationalize the standard bidding documents for procurement by Government. Procurement monitoring website established.
Standard bidding documents adopted currently in use.
Curriculum outdated and not appropriate for training needs of MOF to implement the Budget Law 2008
Further support to curriculum strengthening will be provided by JICA and Vietnamese MOF.

Under the Human Resource Development Masterplan prepared the the MOF, the curriculum of MOF training centers has been reviewed andrevised. In this regard the lecturers at the training center have been provided training, courses have been introduced on publicfinancial management and computing equipment has been provided to training centers. The Vietnamese MOF and JICA continue to supportthis work
MOF did not have capacity building plans for ICT. GFIS was incapable of using GFSconsistent chart of accounts and only deployedin less than 10 ministries.

Stabilizing the GFIS environment, increased training in its usage and improved connectivity. GFIS now functional across allprovinces and capable of producing in-year budget reports. Indicator achieved.

GFIS updated, training provided to more than 200 staff on using GFIS across government, system deployed across all 37 ministriesand 17 provincial finance departments with real-time connectivity, more than 100 staff received training in English, ICT strategyformulated -- demonstrating higher capacity at the Ministry of Finance.

title.narrative: Adoption of and evidence of implementation of a capacity building plan for the Ministry of Finance.

comment.narrative: Achieved. Human Resource Development strategy prepared (with support from JICA) and capacity building measures consistent withthisplan supported by development partners.

Ministry of Finance has prepared a human resource development strategy. This strategy includes capacity building initiatives thatare being supported by the project. Evidence of implementation is: (i) successful centralization of the customs, tax, treasurydepartments; (ii) ability to publish budget execution reports; (iii) technical work on the budget norms; and (iv) publishing ofaudit reports in newspapers.
